messages:
maria (infra): Heads-up — after the kernel 6.4.3 rollout to gpu-pool we started seeing node-exporter and dcgm-exporter OOM/restart loops on p4 instances. Prometheus scrape bursts coincide with the restarts.
maria (infra): sample from node: 
```
Out of memory: Killed process 2345 (node-exporter) total-vm:123456kB, anon-rss:110000kB
Jun 20 09:12:03 gpu-node-12 systemd[1]: dcgm-exporter.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```

james (sre): ugh. is it definitely exporter memory or something spawned by containers? any per-container cardinality spikes? :thinking:

kai (eng-ml): looks like dcgm-exporter is pulling per-container GPU accounting labels we added last month. For our heavy-runtime pods that creates thousands of label combos and explodes memory on the exporter side. I saw similar at scale before.

olga (eng-infra): can we confirm by grepping metrics for high label cardinality? `/api/v1/series?match[]=dcgm_gpu_memory_bytes` for a timeframe should show distinct series count. Also check node-exporter collector flags — filesystem/proc collectors can add noise.

maria (infra): ran quick query, gpu-exporters job had ~18k series at 09:10 vs normal ~1.2k. confirmed high-card.

james (sre): immediate mitigations: 1) reduce scrape frequency for gpu-exporters job to 60s (was 15s). 2) set `scrape_timeout: 10s`. 3) add relabeling to drop `container_id` or `pod` label from dcgm metrics until we patch exporter. 4) increase memory limits on daemonset to stop OOM storms so restarts backoff kicks in.

olga (eng-infra): agree. I'll open a PR for Prometheus scrape config. sample relabel block we can use:
```
- job_name: 'gpu-exporters'
  scrape_interval: 60s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  static_configs:
    - targets: ['<node_exporter_sd>']
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: ["__metrics_path__"]
      regex: ".*dcgm.*"
      action: keep
    - source_labels: ["container", "pod"]
      regex: ".+"
      action: labeldrop
```

kai (eng-ml): longer term we should change exporter to aggregate per-node instead of per-container for GPU metrics or add a flag to disable per-container accounting. I can PR a patch to dcgm-exporter to add `--no-per-container`.

maria (infra): also worth tuning Prom rules — the current gpu-exporter alerts fired on every restart. We should add a small suppression window or require 3 failures in 5m. Alert noise made it harder to triage.

james (sre): +1. I'll adjust alert for `ExporterDown` to `for: 5m` and add a label `severity: warning` before promoting to critical.

olga (eng-infra): quick systemd tweak for daemonset to reduce restart churn (if using systemd on bare nodes): add `RestartSec=30` and `StartLimitBurst=5` so we don't spin in logs. If it's a K8s DaemonSet change liveness probe/wait before kill.

maria (infra): PRs: prometheus config -> https://git.company/redwood/prometheus/compare/patch-gpu-scrape ; dcgm patch branch -> https://git.company/redwood/dcgm-exporter/compare/no-per-container

prometheus-bot: config reload succeeded (hash: a1b2c3) — gpu-exporters scrape_interval=60s applied.

maria (infra): after the change memory use dropped and restarts stopped on the first few nodes. rolling through remainder now.
deploy-bot: DaemonSet/gpu-exporters rolling update started by olga (strategy: maxUnavailable=1)

olga (eng-infra): rolling patch applied to 80% of nodes, monitoring. will keep low scrape rate until dcgm patch lands.

kai (eng-ml): i'll open the exporter PR today and add unit tests for label count. plan: default to per-node and opt-in to per-container for debugging only.

maria (infra): follow-up: remind SRE to add an SLO dashboard panel summarizing series_count for `gpu-exporters` job over time so we detect cardinality regressions earlier.

james (sre): noted, will add a grafana panel and an alert if series_count increases > 3x baseline within 10m.

maria (infra): thanks all — keeping this thread for notes. postmortem if we have any customer impact. :thumbsup:
